history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person wearing a dark hoodie and ripped black jeans sits on a custom purple and black scooter at night. The scooter has a sleek, modern design with iridescent purple body panels and a black checkered seat. The person's face is obscured by the hood of their hoodie, and they are holding something to their mouth, possibly a cigarette or vape. The background is a dimly lit urban street scene at night. There are streetlights casting a warm glow, palm trees and other lush greenery, and other people and scooters in the background, some blurred by motion or distance. The overall mood is cool, urban, and a little mysterious. The color palette is dominated by dark blues, purples, and blacks, with pops of warm light from the streetlamps. The style is realistic with a slightly cinematic feel.
